title: NoSpread
description: Removes vanilla projectile spread randomness, making supported projectiles fire consistently. Works in singleplayer or when installed server-side.
body:
# NoSpread

NoSpread removes vanilla launch randomness from standard projectile shots, making bow accuracy deterministic and improving projectile-based mace techniques like pearl catching.

Without NoSpread, bow shots and pearl catches can depend partly on random spread instead of only player aim and timing.

## Installation

Install on the server, or in singleplayer. A client-only install on multiplayer servers will not affect server-authoritative projectile behavior.

## Behavior

- Removes vanilla projectile launch randomness.
- Keeps projectile accuracy determined by aim and timing.
- Affects server-authoritative projectile behavior.

## Supported versions

- Minecraft Java 1.21 through 1.21.11
- Minecraft Java 26.1 through 26.1.2
